head_south_initial.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: one transparent south/front head sprite for a RimWorld character, Vertin from Reverse: 1999.
Input 1 is the existing approved pawn HEAD and is the edit target / rendering-style authority. Inputs 2-4 are original-character hairstyle evidence only; do not borrow their rendering detail, neck, clothing, composition, text or lighting.
Edit ONLY the hairstyle and hair color of input 1. Preserve its frontal face shape, small restrained grey-green eyes, neutral expression, chin position, upright head, overall head scale, thick near-black outline, and the exact existing low plum hat, blue-grey hatband, bow on viewer RIGHT, and two dark-tipped ribbons. No neck or body.
Replace the inaccurate short shaggy blond bob with Vertin's actual asymmetrical swept-back updo: a deep off-center part, one long broad flowing front lock descending on viewer LEFT alongside the face to just below the jaw with a slight inward curl; a small tidy curved wisp on viewer RIGHT with more of that cheek/ear exposed. Gather the hair into ONE compact LOW coiled bun behind the ear on viewer LEFT (character RIGHT), opposite the hat bow. The bun is an irregular folded rose-like coil of hair, NOT a flower accessory: 2-3 broad interlocking curved locks, one restrained inward spiral, no fine line spaghetti. Its size about one-third the face height, close to skull and just above jaw/nape height. Keep the bun and lock within the existing broad hat width so the head does not become huge. Remove the ring of outward-pointing layered tufts and bottom shag fringe. No second bun, ponytail, braids, long loose back hair.
Hair palette: muted ash-silver grey with faint grey-green/olive undertone, using approximately #b4b8aa base, #d4d5c8 lighter flat area, #82877e muted shadow. Avoid yellow/blond/beige/peach hair. Only 2-3 broad matte hair color shapes, no glossy highlight strips, fine individual hairs, gradients or realistic illumination.
MATCH input 1's bold low-detail 2D pawn treatment: heavy near-black silhouette equivalent to 3-4 native pixels at final 256px canvas, subordinate sparse broken internal lines, mature/tapered rather than infant round face. Preserve all non-hair elements and face landmarks as closely as possible. Head is strictly upright and frontal. Entire isolated head and hat fully visible with transparent padding, real alpha, no background, checkerboard, labels, border, shadow, reference panels or additional views.

MOVE the single coiled bun from the RIGHT SIDE OF THE PICTURE to the LEFT SIDE OF THE PICTURE. The correct bun must visibly project to the LEFT behind the long face-framing lock, at ear/cheek height, as clearly shown in image 2. On the RIGHT side of the picture, beneath the blue hat ribbons, REMOVE the current spiral hair bun completely and make the hair there lie close to the skull behind the visible ear. The lower right contour should be tidy and close, with just one thin inward-curving cheek strand; no loop, round knot or second bun there. This is NOT a request to mirror or flip the image: keep the hat, its bow and ribbons on image RIGHT, and the long foreground lock on image LEFT. Correct asymmetry = image LEFT long lock + low bun; image RIGHT short cheek curl + blue hat bow and ribbons.
Make the new left bun a small low rose-like coil of 2-3 broad curved hair locks, approximately 1/3 face height, tucked behind the long strand rather than a huge external circular ball. Only its left part and lower curve need show in this front view; it should stay within or very close to the hat's leftmost edge. Grey-silver muted hair, 2-3 flat matte shades, no glossy shine or fine strands. Keep the existing face, eyes, jaw/chin, head position and upright attitude, hat silhouette, bow, ribbons, heavy near-black outer lines and sparse inner lines unchanged. Do not enlarge the head or make it more chibi. Keep all non-hair pixels as unchanged as possible.
One isolated HEAD ONLY with hat, no neck/body. Transparent alpha background, no labels, no panels, no shadows.

Keep original hat geometry, accessories and overall head proportions as unchanged as possible. Transparent alpha, complete head and hat with padding, no checkerboard, text, labels, shadow, panels or extra views.
